verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a web-search API product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes the hosted service: SDKs and the CLI call the public Tavily API, the MCP server is a hosted endpoint, and pricing is per credit. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core search engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
